quote: A good idea needs a workable orbit: offer, time, cost and delivery.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use ORBIT STORY STUDIO in Futura with an open orbital arc and one offset node. Avoid a planetary globe; the arc represents connected working questions.
invariants: Use the orbital-reel cover motif to introduce a connected model, not a funnel.
Use the dark navy orbital-reel cover with light Futura titles; retain the separate warm-paper reading field in model layouts.
Keep each model question linked back to the central What must be true prompt.
adaptations: Use the complete orbit on a model map and a partial arc on proposals.
Keep the economic assumptions readable without animation.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
